alsoKnownAs.description: WS-5.8: optional. When present, replaces the prior value wholesale; when absent, the prior value carries forward unchanged -- unlike operationalKeys/services, an ordinary rotation with no reason to touch it shouldn't have to restate it just to avoid silently clearing it.

proof.description: REQ-6-7: one proof per entry in operationalKeys (the new keys being installed), proving possession of itself (REQ-7.2-12) -- required whether authorized by (a) the ward's own current operational key (REQ-7.2-1a) or (b) enough current guardians to meet recovery_threshold (REQ-7.2-1b), each contributing one more proof in the same set.
